name: Devil, Tisiphone
body:
Tisiphone (Greater Fury)
CR 17

This winged woman’s hair seem interspersed with snake bodies. Her serpentine eyes flash with emerald rage and a forked tongue comes out hissing among her fangs as she recites all your sins in an awful litany under her breath.

XP 102,400
LE Medium outsider (devil, evil, extraplanar, lawful, shapechanger)
Init +9; Senses darkvision 60 ft., see in darkness, sense fear, sense madness, true seeing; Perception +33; Aura frightful presence (60 ft., DC 29)

DEFENSE

AC 32, touch 20, flat-footed 22 (+9 Dex, +1 dodge, +12 natural)
hp 264 (23d10+138)
Fort +19, Ref +22, Will +14
Defensive Abilities strengthened by insanity; DR 15/good; Immune fire, poison; Resist acid 10, cold 10; SR 28

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft., fly 100 ft. (perfect)
Melee +1 flaming longsword +29/+24/+19/+14 (1d8+6/19-20 plus 1d6 fire) or +1 flaming scorpion whip +29/+24/+19/+14 (1d4+6 plus 1d6 fire)
Ranged +1 flaming composite longbow +31/+31/+26/+21/+16 (1d8+6/x3 plus 1d6 fire) or rope +28 touch (burning entanglement)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 20th; concentration +28)

Constant—sense fear, sense madness, true seeing
At will—blasphemy (DC 27), greater teleport (self plus 50 lbs. of objects only), invisibility, lightning lash, persistent image (DC 23), rage (self only)
3/day—call infernal tormentor (level 4, 100%), night terrors (DC 24), shadow evocation (DC 23)
1/day—control weather, insanity (DC 25), summon (level 8, 2-5 erinyes, 90%)

Witch Spells Known (CL 17th, concentration +25)

8th Level (5/day)—antipathy (DC 26), stormbolts (DC 26)
7th level (7/day)—harm (DC 25), pox of rumors (DC 25), waves of exhaustion
6th level (7/day)—curse of the outcast (DC 24), hellfire ray (DC 24), whip of ants
5th level (7/day)—apathy (DC 23), feast on fear (DC 23), pessimism (DC 23), waves of fatigue
4th level (8/day)—black tentacles, confusion (DC 22), crushing despair (DC 22), scrying
3rd level (8/day)—ash storm, slave to sin (DC 21), threefold face Lot, vision of hell (DC 21)
2nd level (8/day)—alter self, burning gaze (DC 20), mad hallucination (DC 20), paranoia (DC 20), summon swarm
1st level (8/day)— bungle (DC 19), burning hands (DC 19), command (DC 19), incessant buzzing (DC 19), ray of sickening (DC 19)
0th-Level (at will)—arcane mark, bleed (DC 18), daze (DC 18), detect magic, message, putrefy food and drink, read magic, spark, touch of fatigue (DC 18)

STATISTICS

Str 20, Dex 28, Con 23, Int 20, Wis 25, Cha 27
Base Atk +23; CMB +28 (+41 trip); CMD 49 (51 vs. trip)
Feats Combat Expertise, Combat Reflexes, DodgeB, Flyby Attack, Fury’s Fall, Fury’s Snare, Greater Trip, Improved Trip, Manyshot, MobilityB, Point-Blank Shot, Rapid Shot, Traumatic Spell, Whirlwind Attack
Skills Acrobatics +35, Bluff +34, Diplomacy +31, Escape Artist +35, Fly +43, Intimidate +34, Knowledge (planes, religion) +31, Perception +33, Sense Motive +33, Stealth +35
Languages Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal; telepathy 100 ft.
SQ change shape (Large constrictor snake or Large black mastiff, beast shape II)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Burning Entanglement (Su)

Each tisiphone carries a 50-foot-long rope that entangles opponents of any size as an animate rope spell (CL 20th, DC 30). A tisiphone can hurl its rope 60 feet with no range penalty. A tisiphone’s rope functions only for the tisiphone who made it and no other. A creature that begins its turn entangled by the tisiphone’s rope or scorpion whip takes 4d6 points of fire damage (a successful DC 30 Reflex save halves this damage), as the burning entanglement spell. The save DCs are Dexterity-based.

Burning Wrath (Su)

A tisiphone wields a troika of flaming weapons, and her weapons are considered evil for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. As a standard action, she can imbue one of her weapons with the axiomatic or unholy property for 1 minute. She can only imbue this property in one weapon at a time. If she drops her whip (including using her Fury’s Snare feat) or it is disarmed, she can create a new +1 flaming whip as a swift action. The discarded whip burns to ashes 1d4 rounds later.

Call Infernal Tormentor (Sp)

Three times per day, a tisiphone can animate part of her hair as either a hell hound or a venomous snake swarm. These are considered summoned creatures as per the summon universal monster ability.

Spells A tisiphone cast spells as a 17th-level oracle, except her spells come from the witch spell list.

Strengthened By Insanity (Su)

A tisiphone gains regeneration 5 as long as she is within 30 feet of a creature that she can sense using her sense fear and sense madness spell-like abilities.

ECOLOGY

Environment any (Hell)
Organization solitary, trio (3) or storm (1 plus 2-8 erinyes and 2-12 alectos)
Treasure triple (+1 flaming longsword, +1 flaming scorpion whip, +1 flaming composite longbow, other treasure)

Also called “the dark she-dogs of Hell”, tisiphones (“avengers”) are the elite of erinyes, charged with punishing the most heinous of sins, like homicide or rape, especially against members of one’s own family. The culprit is plagued with insanity and nightmares, condemned to wander shunned by their own kin and community, and even forced to harm themselves and their loved ones, until they die and are brought to Hell, or atone for their deeds.
